Name: Expanded Pufferfish
Author: LucyTheOrange
Description:
Expanded Pufferfish brings brand new pufferfish variants to Stardew Valley by introducing 14 new pufferfish species to the game. Each one features its own time-based conditions, allowing players to explore different fishing strategies.

[b]Enjoying this mod?[/b] Consider [b]endorsing[/b], it goes a long way and helps the mod grow! 💝

🎣 [b]Features:[/b]

🐡 14 new pufferfish species
⚖️ Balanced for difficulty, sell price, and spawn rates
🔍 Works perfectly with vanilla fishing mechanics
📝 Compatible with all existing fishing levels and professions
🧭 Designed for exploration and discovery, no early-game imbalance


[b]🦑 Installation:[/b]

This mod is ready to go right out of the box, while also compatible with any existing save of Stardew Valley 1.6+
No new save needed, simply drag and drop it into your Mods folder.

Steps:

[list]
[*]Download and extract the mod’s .zip file[/*]
[*]Place the folder inside Stardew Valley/Mods[/*]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI installed (required for mods)[/*]
[*]Launch the game and cast your line[/*]
[/list]
[b]📚 Information:[/b]

Fish, and more information can now be found in the [b]Fishing Guide[/b] at the [i][b]bottom of the page[/b][/i], [i]scroll down to check it out![/i]

⚓ [b]Compatibility:[/b]

Built with compatibility in mind, designed to work smoothly alongside other mods, if you have them, or not!

[/list]No known compatibility issues. This mod adds fish without altering core game logic, and closely follows vanilla behavior to ensure compatibility. While every effort is made to ensure compatibility, support cannot be guaranteed for every mod combination. If you encounter a reproducible issue, feel free to report it.

 Feel free to reach out with questions or for collaboration! 🧡


🌍 [b]Translations:[/b]

If you’d like to contribute a translation, or correct an existing one, then message me on Nexus before you publish it. Starting now, all translations will be handled by the respected translators, on their own mod translation page. 💙

[u][b]AI is strictly prohibited[/b][/u]. Code, sprites, and similar generated by these models are not ever accepted[i]. This policy is in place indefinitely and is not subject to change. [/i]🔒
